name: Zelina Innevar
description: Arietta’s sister, a charming traveller who asks others about their pasts, plans and families.
reuseWhen: Use the supplied portrait for appearance continuity. Existing shared artwork depicts the original scene and setting.

assets.description: Zelina asleep with her face turned away in a shared wagon layer with Arietta, bedding and lantern.
Supplied portrait card for Zelina Innevar.
Shared pose of Zelina seated with an open palm and Coppercoil leaning in beside her.

appearance.features: Long dark-brown hair worn in a braid.
appearance.clothing: Rust-red hooded cloak, blue-green scarf, cream tunic, olive trousers and brown boots, with a bedroll and coiled rope.
